description: This file implements the RuntimeManagerHandler class, which manages runtime application lifecycle operations such as start, stop, suspend, resume, and wake, and handles runtime events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles runtime application lifecycle management and event notifications within the plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Inner class that handles runtime events such as start, termination, failure, and state changes, and forwards them to the parent handler.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler instance.

methods.name: ~RuntimeManagerHandler
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the handler instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager by querying the interface and registering for notifications.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters from runtime manager notifications and releases the interface.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime information for a specific application instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts a runtime application with specified parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes up an application instance from suspended or paused state.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerNotification::OnStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when an application has started.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerNotification::OnTerminated
methods.description: Handles the event when an application has terminated.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerNotification::OnFailure
methods.description: Handles the event when an application has failed.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerNotification::OnStateChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when an application's runtime state changes.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Forwards runtime events to the registered event handler.
